featured_reviews.review_text:
I am extremely disappointed with Care Health Insurance. My experience has revealed a massive gap between their promises and their actual service, particularly when it comes to renewals versus new sales.
1. The "Sales vs. Support" Trap
It is incredibly easy to reach their sales team—they will call you back in seconds if they think they’re getting a new premium. However, the moment you need help with a renewal or have a technical issue, they become ghosts. Trying to get a human on the line to discuss renewal terms is a nightmare, and the "support" is practically non-existent compared to the aggressive energy of their sales department.
2. The "30% Renewal Discount" is a Scam
Don’t be fooled by their marketing about earning a 30% discount on renewals via their app. I followed all the rules and installed the Care Health app to track my steps. They require you to hit a 10K step goal, which I did.
However, the app is fundamentally broken:
The step counter stays at default or fails to sync properly.
Even though I was active and met the criteria, the app didn't recognize my progress.
Because their own buggy software failed to track my data, they are now refusing to honor the discount.
3. Consumers Pay for Their Technical Failures
As a consumer, I am now facing the consequences of their technical incompetence by being forced to pay a higher premium. It feels like a "bait and switch" tactic—lure you in with the promise of health-based discounts that are impossible to actually claim because the tracking system is rigged to fail

The Economic Times, covered Star Health's two-decade milestone alongside the launch of Value Plus.

Value Plus is an affordable Health Insurance offering designed to bring wider health protection to young Indians in Tier 2, 3 and 4 cities at nearly 20% lower premiums. It offers high sum-insured covers from ₹7.5 lakh to ₹25 lakh through a curated network of 11,000+ quality hospitals.

20 years in. The next chapter begins now.

"Insurance growth in India is no longer a metro story. The next wave will come from Tier II, Tier III and Tier IV markets.”

The ABSLI Guaranteed Annuity Plus is a non-linked, non-participating, general annuity plan which is ideal for anyone wanting secure, lifelong retirement income. With a wide range of annuity and deferment options, along with premium return and top-up features, it caters to evolving retirement needs.
The key features of this plan are:
•	Guaranteed# lifetime income with your choice of payout frequency: monthly, quarterly, half-yearly, or yearly.
•	Deferred annuity lets you lock current rates and start payouts later (5 - 15 years).
•	Top-up option allows you to increase annuity later, subject to terms.
•	Surrender & loan facilities available under select options (e.g., ROP-linked, deferred).
•	Return of Purchase Price to the nominee on death of the annuitant depending on the plan option chosen.

ABSLI Saral Jeevan Bima is a simple, non-linked, non-participating pure term insurance plan that provides a lump-sum payout to the nominee on the death of the life insured. It offers flexible premium payment options (Single, Limited, or Regular Pay) with coverage for up to 40 years.
The key features are:
•	Death Benefit: Lump sum payable on death (post 45-day waiting period); no maturity or survival benefits.
•	Premium Payment: Single, Limited (5/10 years), or Regular Pay.
•	Sum Assured: ₹5 lakhs to ₹25 lakhs.
•	Waiting Period: 45 days from policy start (only accidental death covered during this period).
•	Entry Age: 18 - 65 years | Policy Term: 5 - 40 years.
•	Optional Rider: Accidental Death Benefit Rider Plus.

The ABSLI Salaried Term Plan is a non-linked non-participating individual pure risk premium life insurance plan which is a versatile and cost-effective insurance solution for salaried professionals, offering multiple payout formats, health benefits, and optional riders. It’s ideal if you want tailored protection, premium refunds, or structured income benefits for your dependents.

The Benefits of this plan are:
•	Term Plan exclusively designed Salaried Individuals.
•	In-built Terminal Illness Benefit: Immediate payment of 50% of sum assured (max ₹2 crore), waiver of future premiums if diagnosed before age 70.
•	Optional Accelerated Critical Illness Rider: Covers up to 42 specified illnesses.

ABSLI Poorna Suraksha Kawach Plan is a non-linked, non-participating term insurance plan that offers comprehensive life cover with six customizable plan options. It includes features like Return of Premium, Increasing/Decreasing Sum Assured, Waiver of Premium on critical illness or disability, and Terminal Illness Benefit. Optional Critical Illness cover can also be added.
The Key features of this plan are:
•	Plan Options: Level Cover, Return of Premium, Early Return of Premium, Increasing/Decreasing Cover, Waiver on CI/TPD.
•	Death Benefit: Lump sum payout on death (based on chosen option).
•	Maturity* Benefit: Available under Return/ One Time Return of Premium options.
•	Terminal Illness Benefit: 50% of Sum Assured paid in advance.
•	Entry Age: 18 to 65 years | Policy Term: 5 to 55 years.
•	Minimum Sum Assured: ₹30 lakhs | Premium Modes: Single, Limited, or Regular Pay.

The ABSLI Platinum Gain Plan is a unit-linked, non-participating individual life insurance savings plan (ULIP) that combines life cover with market-linked investment options - risk borne by the policyholder. This plan offers sophisticated fund-management features and wealth-boosting elements, making it a compelling ULIP for experienced investors. 
The benefits of this plan are:
•	Death Benefit: Higher of Sum Assured (adjusted for last 2 years’ withdrawals), Fund Value, or 105% of total premiums paid.
•	Maturity1 Benefit: Fund Value plus refund of mortality & premium allocation charges, available as lump sum or via structured payouts.
•	Partial/Full Liquidity: Allowed only after 5-year lock-in.

The ABSLI Nishchit Aayush Plan is a non-linked non-participating individual savings life insurance plan that offers a blend of stable income, lump sum maturity benefits, and life protection. With abundant customization across term, income type, and payout frequency, it's a structured choice for financially prudent individuals seeking certainty and flexibility. Riders provide added coverage. Its non-linked, non-participating nature ensures conservative, low-risk design.
The features of this plan are:
•	Benefit Options: Long Term Income (for a fixed policy term) and Whole Life Income (till age 100)
•	Income Variants (choose one): Level Income (with or without lumpsum or return-of-premium or Enhanced Lumpsum) or Increasing Income (rises ~5% every 5 years) 
•	Deferment Choice: Start income payouts immediately or they can be defered till 5 years, based on deferment choice.

ABSLI Guaranteed Milestone Plan is a non-linked, non-participating life insurance savings plan that offers guaranteed maturity and death benefits along with monthly guaranteed additions throughout the policy term. It ensures financial protection and disciplined savings with zero market risk.

•	Guaranteed# Additions: Credited monthly during the policy term.
•	Death Benefit: Higher of 15× annual premium, 105% of premiums paid, or Maturity Sum Assured (with additions).
•	Maturity Benefit1: Maturity Sum Assured + accrued Guaranteed Additions.
•	Policy Term: 12 to 26 years; Premium Payment Term: 6 to 12 years (varies with term).

•	Entry Age: 30 days to 60 years.
•	Minimum Premium: ₹15,000 annually.
